name: Chris Workplace 1000
description: 1000 meanings for shop, project, business, and everyday English in Hong Kong.

senses.glossEn: A hand tool with a toothed blade, used for cutting wood or other hard material.
senses.glossTc: 有鋸齒的手工具，用來鋸開木材或其他硬物。

examples.en: He used a saw to cut the shelf to size.
examples.tc: 他用鋸子把層板鋸成所需長度。

examples.en: The hardware shop near the MTR sold us a new saw.
examples.tc: 港鐵站附近的五金店賣了一把新鋸給我們。

examples.en: Keep the saw off the till counter after you finish the display.
examples.tc: 做完陳列後，不要把鋸子放在收銀櫃台上。

synonyms.difference: A handsaw is one common type of saw, not every cutting tool.

senses.glossEn: Past tense of see: noticed or looked at someone or something.
senses.glossTc: see 的過去式：看見或注意到某人或某物。

examples.en: I saw the email this morning but have not replied yet.
examples.tc: 我今早看到那封電郵，但還未回覆。

examples.en: She saw the queue from the street and came in later.
examples.tc: 她在街上看到排隊，於是稍後才進來。

examples.en: We saw the supplier at the station after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後我們在車站遇見供應商。

senses.glossEn: To look at written words and understand their meaning.
senses.glossTc: 看文字並理解其意思。

examples.en: Please read the contract before you sign it.
examples.tc: 請先閱讀合約，再簽署。

examples.en: I read WhatsApp slowly when the train is crowded.
examples.tc: 港鐵擠迫時，我會慢慢看 WhatsApp。

examples.en: Can you read the till message to the customer?
examples.tc: 你可以把收銀機上的訊息讀給顧客聽嗎？

synonyms.difference: Go through often means examine in detail, not only decode the words.

senses.glossEn: Past tense of read: finished looking at and understanding a text.
senses.glossTc: read 的過去式：已經看過並理解某段文字。

examples.en: I read your proposal last night and marked two questions.
examples.tc: 我昨晚已讀過你的建議書，並標了兩個問題。

examples.en: He read the WhatsApp from the supplier before opening the shop.
examples.tc: 開店前他已看過供應商的 WhatsApp。

examples.en: They read the refund policy on the till screen.
examples.tc: 他們在收銀機螢幕上看過退款政策。

senses.glossEn: A business that keeps money, makes payments, and lends money.
senses.glossTc: 保管金錢、處理付款及借貸的機構。

examples.en: The shop pays takings into the bank every evening.
examples.tc: 店舖每晚都會把營業額存入銀行。

examples.en: I will go to the bank after the supplier meeting.
examples.tc: 供應商會議後我會去銀行。

examples.en: The bank closed the counter before we reached the queue.
examples.tc: 我們排到之前，銀行櫃位已關門。

synonyms.difference: A lender may be a bank, but a bank also holds deposits and runs accounts.

senses.glossEn: The land along the side of a river or canal.
senses.glossTc: 河或運河兩旁的岸邊土地。

examples.en: We walked along the river bank after lunch.
examples.tc: 午飯後我們沿河岸散步。

examples.en: The cafe on the bank is a short walk from the MTR.
examples.tc: 河岸那間茶餐廳由港鐵走一小段就到。

examples.en: Do not leave the delivery boxes on the wet bank.
examples.tc: 不要把送貨紙箱留在潮濕的岸邊。

synonyms.difference: Shore is more often used for a sea or lake than a river.

senses.glossEn: To shut something, or to bring a matter to an end.
senses.glossTc: 關上某物，或把一件事結束。

examples.en: Please close the till before you leave the shop.
examples.tc: 離開店舖前請關好收銀機。

examples.en: We will close the complaint after the refund is paid.
examples.tc: 退款完成後，我們會把投訴結案。

examples.en: Close the WhatsApp chat if the supplier has confirmed.
examples.tc: 若供應商已確認，便可結束該 WhatsApp 對話。

synonyms.difference: Shut is usually physical. Close can also end a deal or a file.

senses.glossEn: Near in space, time, or relationship.
senses.glossTc: 在距離、時間或關係上接近。

examples.en: The warehouse is close to the MTR station.
examples.tc: 貨倉鄰近港鐵站。

examples.en: The deadline is close, so send the update tonight.
examples.tc: 截止日期臨近，今晚請把最新情況寄出。

examples.en: She is a close friend of the shop owner.
examples.tc: 她是店主的好友。

synonyms.difference: Near is mainly about distance. Close can also describe a relationship.

senses.glossEn: To arrange in advance to have a place, time, or service.
senses.glossTc: 預先安排位置、時間或服務。

examples.en: Can you book a meeting room for Thursday morning?
examples.tc: 你能否預訂星期四上午的會議室？

examples.en: I booked a table near the MTR after work.
examples.tc: 下班後我在港鐵站附近訂了枱。

examples.en: Please book the courier before the till closes.
examples.tc: 請在收銀機關機前預訂速遞。

synonyms.difference: Reserve is slightly more formal; both can mean hold a place.

senses.glossEn: To examine something so you know it is correct or complete.
senses.glossTc: 檢查某事物，確認它正確或齊全。

examples.en: Check the stock count before we open tomorrow.
examples.tc: 明天開店前先核對存貨數目。

examples.en: I will check WhatsApp for the supplier's reply.
examples.tc: 我會查看 WhatsApp，看供應商有沒有回覆。

examples.en: Please check the till tape against the cash drawer.
examples.tc: 請把收銀機紙帶與錢箱核對。

synonyms.difference: Verify stresses proving that something is true, not only looking at it.

senses.glossEn: To give attention to a problem and start dealing with it.
senses.glossTc: 正視問題並着手處理。

examples.en: We need to address the delay before it affects the launch.
examples.tc: 我們要先處理延誤，以免影響推出時間。

examples.en: The meeting will address the customer queue at lunch.
examples.tc: 會議會處理午飯時顧客排隊的問題。

examples.en: Please address the WhatsApp complaint today.
examples.tc: 請今天處理該則 WhatsApp 投訴。

synonyms.difference: Deal with is more general. Address often names the issue first.

senses.glossEn: Happening or being used now.
senses.glossTc: 現正發生或現正使用的。

examples.en: The current price list replaces last month's version.
examples.tc: 現行價目表已取代上個月的版本。

examples.en: What is the current waiting time at the till?
examples.tc: 現時收銀處的等候時間是多久？

examples.en: Save the current file before you leave the MTR.
examples.tc: 離開港鐵前先儲存目前這個檔案。

synonyms.difference: Present can also mean in the room. Current usually means latest.

senses.glossEn: The speaker or writer; used to talk about yourself.
senses.glossTc: 說話或書寫的人用來指自己。

examples.en: I will send the file after lunch.
examples.tc: 我午飯後會把檔案寄出。

examples.en: I can cover the till until six.
examples.tc: 我可以看收銀看到六時。

examples.en: I saw the supplier on the MTR this morning.
examples.tc: 我今早在港鐵見到供應商。

senses.glossEn: The person or people being spoken or written to.
senses.glossTc: 指正在對話或收信的對方。

examples.en: Can you confirm the delivery time?
examples.tc: 你能否確認送貨時間？

examples.en: You can pay at the till or by FPS.
examples.tc: 你可以在收銀處付款，或用轉數快。

examples.en: Thank you for waiting near the door.
examples.tc: 謝謝你在門口附近等候。

senses.glossEn: The speaker and at least one other person.
senses.glossTc: 指自己連同至少另一人。

examples.en: We should test the till before Saturday.
examples.tc: 我們應在星期六前先測試收銀機。

examples.en: We can meet the supplier after the MTR rush.
examples.tc: 我們可以在港鐵繁忙時段過後見供應商。

examples.en: We sent the WhatsApp update before the deadline.
examples.tc: 我們在截止日期前已把 WhatsApp 最新情況寄出。

senses.glossEn: People or things already known in the conversation, not you or me.
senses.glossTc: 指對話中已知、但不是你或我的人或事物。

examples.en: They asked for a refund this afternoon.
examples.tc: 他們今天下午要求退款。

examples.en: They will approve the discount after the meeting.
examples.tc: 他們會在會議後批准折扣。

examples.en: If they miss the MTR, the delivery will be late.
examples.tc: 若他們趕不上港鐵，送貨便會遲到。

senses.glossEn: To make a process simpler and faster by removing extra steps.
senses.glossTc: 精簡流程，去掉多餘步驟，使其更快捷。

examples.en: We should streamline the approval process before automating it.
examples.tc: 我們應先簡化審批流程，再將其自動化。

examples.en: Streamline the refund steps so the till is not blocked.
examples.tc: 精簡退款步驟，以免收銀機被堵住。

examples.en: The shop streamlined WhatsApp orders last month.
examples.tc: 店舖上個月精簡了 WhatsApp 訂貨流程。

synonyms.difference: Simplify can mean make easier to understand. Streamline usually means remove delay from a process.

senses.glossEn: A series of steps used to get a result at work.
senses.glossTc: 為達成結果而設的一連串步驟。

examples.en: The refund process takes two working days.
examples.tc: 退款流程需時兩個工作天。

examples.en: Write the process on one page before the meeting.
examples.tc: 開會前先把流程寫成一頁。

examples.en: This process needs approval from the shop owner.
examples.tc: 此流程需要店主審批。

synonyms.difference: A procedure is often a written rule. A process is the work as it actually happens.

senses.glossEn: To officially agree that something may go ahead.
senses.glossTc: 正式同意某事可以進行。

examples.en: The manager will approve the discount if it stays under ten percent.
examples.tc: 只要折扣不超過一成，經理便會批准。

examples.en: Please approve the overtime before Friday's deadline.
examples.tc: 請在星期五截止日期前批准加班。

examples.en: They approved the supplier after the sample meeting.
examples.tc: 樣本會議後他們批准了該供應商。

synonyms.difference: Authorise stresses giving permission. Approve can also mean judge something as acceptable.

senses.glossEn: The latest time by which work must be finished.
senses.glossTc: 工作必須完成的最後期限。

examples.en: The report deadline is Friday at 5 p.m.
examples.tc: 報告截止日期是星期五下午五時。

examples.en: Tell the supplier the deadline in WhatsApp tonight.
examples.tc: 今晚用 WhatsApp 告訴供應商截止日期。

examples.en: We moved the till upgrade deadline after the holiday.
examples.tc: 假期後我們把收銀系統升級的截止日期延後。

synonyms.difference: Due date is common for bills and homework. Deadline is common for work tasks.

senses.glossEn: A person or group affected by a project and able to influence it.
senses.glossTc: 受項目影響、亦能影響項目的人或團體。

examples.en: Shop staff are stakeholders in the new till system.
examples.tc: 店舖同事也是新收銀系統的持份者。

examples.en: Invite every stakeholder to Friday's meeting.
examples.tc: 邀請每位持份者出席星期五的會議。

examples.en: The landlord is a key stakeholder for the shop works.
examples.tc: 業主是店舖工程的主要持份者。

synonyms.difference: Interested party is legal wording. Stakeholder is everyday project language.

senses.glossEn: What a project will and will not include.
senses.glossTc: 項目包括和不包括的範圍。

examples.en: Training videos are outside the scope of this week's work.
examples.tc: 培訓影片不在本週工作範圍內。

examples.en: Keep the new shelves inside the agreed scope.
examples.tc: 新層架須保持在已同意的範圍內。

examples.en: The customer app is not in scope until approval.
examples.tc: 未獲審批前，顧客應用程式不在範圍內。

synonyms.difference: Range is general size. Scope names agreed project boundaries.

senses.glossEn: A possible problem that could harm a plan if it happens.
senses.glossTc: 一旦發生便可能損害計劃的潛在問題。

examples.en: Late stock delivery is the main risk this month.
examples.tc: 貨物遲送是本月的主要風險。

examples.en: A long queue is a risk to the Saturday experience.
examples.tc: 排隊過長會影響星期六的顧客體驗，構成風險。

examples.en: Write the cash risk in the meeting notes.
examples.tc: 把現金風險寫進會議紀錄。

synonyms.difference: A threat is often more hostile. A risk can be an ordinary delay or cost.

senses.glossEn: To give the latest information, or to change something so it is current.
senses.glossTc: 提供最新資料，或把事物改成最新狀態。

examples.en: Please update the team after you speak to the supplier.
examples.tc: 與供應商談完後，請向團隊匯報最新情況。

examples.en: Update the till prices before we open.
examples.tc: 開店前先更新收銀機價錢。

examples.en: I will update you on WhatsApp when the MTR is clear.
examples.tc: 港鐵不擠時，我會用 WhatsApp 向你匯報。

synonyms.difference: Inform can be any news. Update means the news is newer than before.

senses.glossEn: A planned time when people talk about work together.
senses.glossTc: 預先安排、一起討論工作的時間。

examples.en: The supplier meeting starts at ten.
examples.tc: 供應商會議十時開始。

examples.en: We held a short meeting beside the till after closing.
examples.tc: 關門後我們在收銀處旁開了短會。

examples.en: Put the deadline on the meeting agenda.
examples.tc: 把截止日期寫進會議議程。

synonyms.difference: A discussion can be informal. A meeting is usually scheduled.

senses.glossEn: A finished piece of work that you have promised to hand over.
senses.glossTc: 已承諾要交出的完成工作成果。

examples.en: The first deliverable is a one-page process map.
examples.tc: 第一項交付成果是一頁流程圖。

examples.en: The till training notes are this week's deliverable.
examples.tc: 收銀培訓筆記是本週的交付成果。

examples.en: Send each deliverable to the stakeholder before Friday.
examples.tc: 星期五前把每項交付成果寄給持份者。

synonyms.difference: Output is any result. A deliverable is an agreed hand-over.

senses.glossEn: A person who buys goods or services from a shop or business.
senses.glossTc: 向店舖或公司購買貨品或服務的人。

examples.en: A regular customer asked about the new opening hours.
examples.tc: 一位熟客詢問新的營業時間。

examples.en: The customer waited at the till with a WhatsApp voucher.
examples.tc: 顧客拿着 WhatsApp 優惠券在收銀處等候。

examples.en: Thank the customer before you pack the bag.
examples.tc: 裝袋前先向顧客道謝。

synonyms.difference: Client is more common for professional services. Customer is more common in shops.

senses.glossEn: A bill that lists what was sold and how much must be paid.
senses.glossTc: 列出已售項目及應付款額的帳單。

examples.en: Please send the invoice to the accounts email.
examples.tc: 請把發票寄到會計電郵。

examples.en: The supplier WhatsApped a photo of the invoice.
examples.tc: 供應商用 WhatsApp 傳了發票相片。

examples.en: Check the invoice against the till delivery note.
examples.tc: 請把發票與收銀處的送貨單核對。

synonyms.difference: Bill is everyday. Invoice is the formal document used between businesses.

senses.glossEn: Money a business receives from sales before costs are taken off.
senses.glossTc: 扣除成本前，生意從銷售收到的金錢。

examples.en: Weekend revenue rose after we extended opening hours.
examples.tc: 延長營業時間後，週末收入上升。

examples.en: Till revenue dropped when the MTR exit was closed.
examples.tc: 港鐵出口關閉時，收銀營業額下跌。

examples.en: Put last week's revenue in the meeting slide.
examples.tc: 把上週收入寫進會議投影片。

synonyms.difference: Income can include wages or rent. Revenue usually means sales money.

senses.glossEn: A written plan offered for other people to accept or reject.
senses.glossTc: 供對方接受或拒絕的書面計劃。

examples.en: Her proposal explains how the shop can cut waiting time.
examples.tc: 她的建議書說明店舖如何縮短等候時間。

examples.en: Send the proposal to the supplier before the deadline.
examples.tc: 截止日期前把建議書寄給供應商。

examples.en: We discussed the proposal in the WhatsApp group.
examples.tc: 我們在 WhatsApp 群組討論了該建議書。

synonyms.difference: A plan can stay internal. A proposal is offered to someone else.

senses.glossEn: Comments on how well something worked, used to improve it.
senses.glossTc: 關於效果好壞的意見，用來改進。

examples.en: Customer feedback said the queue felt too long.
examples.tc: 顧客意見指排隊時間令人覺得太長。

examples.en: Ask for feedback after the till training.
examples.tc: 收銀培訓後請收集意見。

examples.en: The WhatsApp feedback helped us change the process.
examples.tc: WhatsApp 上的意見幫助我們改了流程。

synonyms.difference: Comments can be any remarks. Feedback is given so work can improve.

senses.glossEn: Money paid back to a customer.
senses.glossTc: 退回給顧客的金錢。

examples.en: We issued a refund after the item arrived damaged.
examples.tc: 貨品送達時已損壞，我們已辦理退款。

examples.en: The till needs a manager code for a refund.
examples.tc: 收銀機辦理退款需要經理密碼。

examples.en: She asked for a refund by WhatsApp the same night.
examples.tc: 她當晚用 WhatsApp 要求退款。

synonyms.difference: Reimbursement often pays back a cost someone already spent. A refund returns a purchase price.

senses.glossEn: A line of people waiting for their turn.
senses.glossTc: 輪候的一排人。

examples.en: The lunch queue reached the door by twelve.
examples.tc: 中午十二時，午膳排隊已排到門口。

examples.en: Open a second till if the queue is past the shelves.
examples.tc: 若排隊超過貨架，就開第二部收銀機。

examples.en: There was a queue at the MTR ticket machine.
examples.tc: 港鐵售票機前有人排隊。

synonyms.difference: Line is more common in American English. Queue is the usual British and Hong Kong word.

senses.glossEn: How something feels to a person while they use a shop or service.
senses.glossTc: 顧客使用店舖或服務時的感受。

examples.en: A slow queue can spoil an otherwise good shopping experience.
examples.tc: 排隊太慢，即使其他環節不錯，購物體驗也會變差。

examples.en: We want a calm experience at the till on Saturdays.
examples.tc: 我們希望星期六收銀處的體驗保持冷靜有序。

examples.en: The WhatsApp order experience should feel simple.
examples.tc: WhatsApp 訂貨體驗應讓人覺得簡單。

synonyms.difference: An impression is a first judgment. Experience covers the whole visit.

senses.glossEn: A statement that something is wrong or not good enough.
senses.glossTc: 指某事有問題或未達標準的陳述。

examples.en: We logged the complaint and offered a replacement the same day.
examples.tc: 我們已記錄投訴，並在當日提供更換。

examples.en: The complaint about the till wait came by WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 有關收銀等候的投訴是經 WhatsApp 傳來的。

examples.en: Handle the complaint before the next customer reaches the counter.
examples.tc: 下一位顧客到櫃位前，先處理好這宗投訴。

synonyms.difference: An objection is often raised in a meeting. A complaint is usually about service or a product.

senses.glossEn: To start selling or offering something new in public.
senses.glossTc: 公開推出新產品或新服務。

examples.en: We will launch the new loyalty card in October.
examples.tc: 我們將於十月推出新的會員卡。

examples.en: Do not launch the app until the till can take the code.
examples.tc: 收銀機能讀取代碼前，不要推出應用程式。

examples.en: They launched a weekend stall near the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 他們在港鐵出口附近推出週末檔攤。

synonyms.difference: Release is common for software. Launch often includes the public start.

senses.glossEn: To change the main direction of a business when the first plan is not working.
senses.glossTc: 原計劃行不通時，改變生意的主要方向。

examples.en: They pivoted from a food stall to weekend catering.
examples.tc: 他們由小吃攤轉向週末到會。

examples.en: If shop traffic stays low, we may pivot to WhatsApp orders.
examples.tc: 若店舖人流持續偏低，我們或會轉向 WhatsApp 訂貨。

examples.en: The team pivoted after the supplier raised prices.
examples.tc: 供應商加價後，團隊改變了方向。

synonyms.difference: Change course is ordinary English. Pivot is business slang for a planned turn.

senses.glossEn: The money moving in and out of a business over a period.
senses.glossTc: 一段時間內流入和流出生意的現金。

examples.en: Slow cash flow made it hard to pay the supplier early.
examples.tc: 現金流偏慢，難以提早支付供應商。

examples.en: Weekend cash flow looks healthier after the till change.
examples.tc: 改了收銀安排後，週末現金流看來較穩。

examples.en: Track cash flow before you approve the extra stock.
examples.tc: 審批額外存貨前，先追蹤現金流。

synonyms.difference: Liquidity is a finance term for how easily assets become cash. Cash flow is the actual movement of money.

senses.glossEn: To make a machine or program do work that people used to do by hand.
senses.glossTc: 改由機器或程式完成以往人手做的工作。

examples.en: Do not automate a messy process; clean it first.
examples.tc: 不要先把混亂流程自動化；應先理順。

examples.en: We will automate stock alerts after the till upgrade.
examples.tc: 收銀系統升級後，我們會把存貨提示自動化。

examples.en: Can we automate the WhatsApp order confirmation?
examples.tc: 我們可以把 WhatsApp 訂單確認自動化嗎？

synonyms.difference: Computerise means put work on a computer. Automate means the computer then does the steps.

senses.glossEn: To put a system or update into real use.
senses.glossTc: 把系統或更新正式投入使用。

examples.en: We will deploy the till update after closing time.
examples.tc: 我們會在關門後部署收銀系統更新。

examples.en: Do not deploy during the Saturday queue.
examples.tc: 星期六排隊高峰期間不要部署。

examples.en: IT will deploy the backup tool this week.
examples.tc: 資訊科技部本週會部署備份工具。

synonyms.difference: Roll out often means introduce to users in stages. Deploy is the technical put-live step.

senses.glossEn: A copy of files kept so work can be restored if the original is lost.
senses.glossTc: 另存的檔案副本，以便原本遺失時還原。

examples.en: Keep a backup of your study file outside this phone.
examples.tc: 請在這部手機以外另存學習檔備份。

examples.en: The till backup runs after midnight.
examples.tc: 收銀機備份在午夜後執行。

examples.en: Send the meeting notes backup to WhatsApp files.
examples.tc: 把會議紀錄備份傳到 WhatsApp 檔案。

synonyms.difference: Any copy is a copy. A backup exists specifically for recovery.

senses.glossEn: Not connected to the internet, but still able to use saved material.
senses.glossTc: 未連接互聯網，但仍可使用已儲存的資料。

examples.en: The installed pack works offline after you prepare it.
examples.tc: 完成準備後，已安裝的內容可離線使用。

examples.en: The till can take cash offline if the line drops.
examples.tc: 若網絡中斷，收銀機仍可離線收現金。

examples.en: Save the file for offline reading on the MTR.
examples.tc: 把檔案儲存，以便在港鐵離線閱讀。

senses.glossEn: To arrange for something to happen at a particular time.
senses.glossTc: 安排某事在指定時間發生。

examples.en: Let's schedule the staff briefing for Monday morning.
examples.tc: 我們把員工簡介安排在星期一上午。

examples.en: Schedule the courier after the till closes.
examples.tc: 安排速遞在收銀機關機後來取件。

examples.en: Can we schedule a supplier call around the MTR ride?
examples.tc: 我們可否把供應商通話安排在乘港鐵前後？

synonyms.difference: Arrange is broader. Schedule always sets a time.

senses.glossEn: To say that something is true or definitely arranged.
senses.glossTc: 表明某事屬實，或已確定安排。

examples.en: Please confirm that the Saturday shift is covered.
examples.tc: 請確認星期六的更期已有人頂。

examples.en: Confirm the order on WhatsApp before we pack it.
examples.tc: 包裝前請先用 WhatsApp 確認訂單。

examples.en: The customer confirmed pickup at the till.
examples.tc: 顧客確認在收銀處取貨。

synonyms.difference: Verify checks evidence. Confirm can also mean give a definite yes.

senses.glossEn: To discuss terms until both sides can accept an agreement.
senses.glossTc: 雙方商討條件，直至可以接受協議。

examples.en: We negotiated a longer payment period with the supplier.
examples.tc: 我們與供應商談妥較長的付款期。

examples.en: She will negotiate the stall rent after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後她會商討檔位租金。

examples.en: Do not negotiate a discount at the till without approval.
examples.tc: 未獲審批，不要在收銀處商討折扣。

synonyms.difference: Bargain often means argue over price. Negotiate can cover time, scope, or terms.

senses.glossEn: To contact someone again about a matter that is not finished.
senses.glossTc: 就尚未完成的事情再次聯絡對方。

examples.en: I will follow up with the supplier if we have no reply by noon.
examples.tc: 若中午前仍未回覆，我會再跟供應商跟進。

examples.en: Please follow up the refund after the till report prints.
examples.tc: 收銀報告列印後，請跟進退款。

examples.en: Follow up on WhatsApp, not only by email.
examples.tc: 請用 WhatsApp 跟進，不要只發電郵。

synonyms.difference: Chase is informal and can sound impatient. Follow up is the usual workplace wording.

senses.glossEn: A polite word used when asking for something.
senses.glossTc: 提出要求時表示禮貌的用語。

examples.en: Please wait here while I check the stockroom.
examples.tc: 請在這裏稍候，我去貨倉查看。

examples.en: Please send the invoice before the deadline.
examples.tc: 請在截止日期前把發票寄出。

examples.en: Two bags, please.
examples.tc: 請給兩個袋子。

senses.glossEn: To tell someone you are grateful.
senses.glossTc: 向對方表示感謝。

examples.en: Thank the customer before you hand over the bag.
examples.tc: 把袋子交給顧客前，先向對方道謝。

examples.en: I want to thank the team for covering the till.
examples.tc: 我想多謝同事頂了收銀。

examples.en: Thank you for the WhatsApp update on the train.
examples.tc: 謝謝你在車上用 WhatsApp 更新情況。

senses.glossEn: To make it easier for someone to do something.
senses.glossTc: 協助別人，使事情較容易完成。

examples.en: I can help you find a smaller size.
examples.tc: 我可以幫你找細一碼。

examples.en: Can you help me pack before the queue grows?
examples.tc: 排隊變長前，你能幫我裝袋嗎？

examples.en: This note will help the new staff close the till.
examples.tc: 這張便條能幫助新同事關收銀機。

synonyms.difference: Assist is more formal. Help is the ordinary word.

senses.glossEn: Used to apologise or to show you regret a problem.
senses.glossTc: 用來道歉，或表示對問題感到抱歉。

examples.en: Sorry for the wait; the next till is opening now.
examples.tc: 抱歉讓你等候；下一個收銀櫃位現正開放。

examples.en: I am sorry the supplier missed today's deadline.
examples.tc: 供應商趕不及今天的截止日期，我很抱歉。

examples.en: Sorry, this carriage is too crowded to talk.
examples.tc: 抱歉，這卡太擠，不方便談話。

senses.glossEn: To give money so you can have something.
senses.glossTc: 付款以換取某物。

examples.en: I need to buy more paper bags before Saturday.
examples.tc: 週末前我要再買多些紙袋。

examples.en: Did you buy lunch near the MTR?
examples.tc: 你有沒有在港鐵站附近買午餐？

examples.en: The shop will buy stock from a new supplier.
examples.tc: 店舖會向新供應商入貨。

synonyms.difference: Purchase is more formal and common on invoices.

senses.glossEn: To give something to someone in return for money.
senses.glossTc: 把東西交給對方以換取金錢。

examples.en: We sell phone cases next to the till.
examples.tc: 我們在收銀處旁邊賣手機套。

examples.en: Do you still sell the weekend lunch set?
examples.tc: 你們還有賣週末午餐套餐嗎？

examples.en: The stall sells drinks to people leaving the MTR.
examples.tc: 檔攤賣飲料給剛出港鐵的人。

synonyms.difference: Offer can mean make available. Sell means money changes hands.

senses.glossEn: To give money for goods, work, or a bill.
senses.glossTc: 為貨品、工作或帳單付出金錢。

examples.en: You can pay by Octopus or FPS at this till.
examples.tc: 這個收銀處可用八達通或轉數快付款。

examples.en: I will pay the supplier on Friday.
examples.tc: 我星期五會付款給供應商。

examples.en: Please pay before you leave the shop.
examples.tc: 離開店舖前請先付款。

synonyms.difference: Settle often means pay a remaining amount to close an account.

senses.glossEn: To stay until something happens or someone is ready.
senses.glossTc: 留在某處，直至事情發生或對方準備好。

examples.en: Please wait here while I check the stockroom.
examples.tc: 請在這裏稍候，我去貨倉查看。

examples.en: Customers wait at the till if the queue is long.
examples.tc: 排隊長時，顧客會在收銀處等候。

examples.en: I waited for the WhatsApp reply on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上等 WhatsApp 回覆。

senses.glossEn: To make something not shut, or to start business for the day.
senses.glossTc: 打開某物，或開始當日營業。

examples.en: We open the shop at ten on weekdays.
examples.tc: 平日我們十時開店。

examples.en: Can you open the till for the next customer?
examples.tc: 你可以為下一位顧客開收銀機嗎？

examples.en: Open the WhatsApp chat and send the address.
examples.tc: 打開 WhatsApp 對話，把地址寄出。

senses.glossEn: To say a question or request so you can get information or help.
senses.glossTc: 提出問題或要求，以取得資料或協助。

examples.en: Ask the customer if they need a bag.
examples.tc: 問問顧客是否需要袋子。

examples.en: I asked the supplier for a later delivery.
examples.tc: 我向供應商要求延後送貨。

examples.en: Please ask in the meeting, not only on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 請在會議上發問，不要只在 WhatsApp 問。

synonyms.difference: Enquire is more formal, often used in written business English.

senses.glossEn: To give information to someone in words.
senses.glossTc: 用說話把資料告訴對方。

examples.en: Tell the next customer the till is free.
examples.tc: 告訴下一位顧客收銀處已經得閒。

examples.en: Please tell me the deadline in one sentence.
examples.tc: 請用一句話告訴我截止日期。

examples.en: She told the team on WhatsApp that the MTR was delayed.
examples.tc: 她在 WhatsApp 告訴同事港鐵誤點。

synonyms.difference: Inform is more formal and often written.

senses.glossEn: To phone someone, or to shout to get their attention.
senses.glossTc: 致電給某人，或大聲叫以引起注意。

examples.en: I will call the supplier if WhatsApp stays quiet.
examples.tc: 若 WhatsApp 一直沒回覆，我會致電供應商。

examples.en: Call me when you reach the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 你到港鐵出口時致電給我。

examples.en: Please call the next number at the till.
examples.tc: 請在收銀處叫下一個號碼。

synonyms.difference: Phone always means use the telephone. Call can also mean shout a name.

senses.glossEn: To cause a message, file, or parcel to go to someone.
senses.glossTc: 把訊息、檔案或包裹送到對方。

examples.en: Send the invoice after you close the till.
examples.tc: 關收銀機後把發票寄出。

examples.en: I sent a WhatsApp photo of the damaged box.
examples.tc: 我用 WhatsApp 傳了損壞箱子的相片。

examples.en: Please send the file before you get on the MTR.
examples.tc: 上港鐵前請把檔案寄出。

senses.glossEn: To get something that is given or sent to you.
senses.glossTc: 收到別人給予或寄出的東西。

examples.en: Did you receive the supplier's WhatsApp?
examples.tc: 你收到供應商的 WhatsApp 嗎？

examples.en: We receive parcels at the back door, not the till.
examples.tc: 我們在後門收包裹，不在收銀處收。

examples.en: I received the approval on the train.
examples.tc: 我在火車上收到審批。

synonyms.difference: Get is the everyday word. Receive is more formal.

senses.glossEn: To reach a place.
senses.glossTc: 到達某地。

examples.en: The stock should arrive before we open.
examples.tc: 存貨應在我們開店前送到。

examples.en: I will message you when I arrive at the MTR.
examples.tc: 我到港鐵時會發訊息給你。

examples.en: A customer arrived while the till was still closed.
examples.tc: 收銀機還未開，已有顧客到達。

synonyms.difference: Reach stresses getting as far as a place. Arrive is the moment you get there.

senses.glossEn: To go away from a place.
senses.glossTc: 離開某地。

examples.en: Please leave the keys beside the till.
examples.tc: 請把鎖匙放在收銀處旁邊才離開。

examples.en: I leave home early to miss the MTR crush.
examples.tc: 我提早出門，避開港鐵擠迫。

examples.en: Do not leave the shop until the alarm is set.
examples.tc: 未設定警報前不要離開店舖。

senses.glossEn: To move on foot.
senses.glossTc: 步行移動。

examples.en: Walk to the warehouse; it is close to the station.
examples.tc: 步行去貨倉吧，那裏鄰近車站。

examples.en: We walked the customer to the till.
examples.tc: 我們陪顧客走到收銀處。

examples.en: I walk from the MTR even when it rains.
examples.tc: 即使下雨，我也由港鐵步行。

senses.glossEn: To move something into your hands or to use a route or vehicle.
senses.glossTc: 把東西拿到手上，或乘搭某交通工具。

examples.en: Take a ticket and wait for your number.
examples.tc: 取籌，然後等候你的號碼。

examples.en: I take the MTR to the supplier on Tuesdays.
examples.tc: 星期二我乘港鐵去見供應商。

examples.en: Please take this bag to the till.
examples.tc: 請把這個袋子拿到收銀處。

senses.glossEn: To hand something to someone.
senses.glossTc: 把東西交給對方。

examples.en: Give the receipt to the customer.
examples.tc: 把收據交給顧客。

examples.en: I will give you the keys after closing.
examples.tc: 關門後我會把鎖匙給你。

examples.en: Give me five minutes to check WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 給我五分鐘查看 WhatsApp。

synonyms.difference: Hand often means pass with your hands. Give is broader.

senses.glossEn: To obtain, receive, or become.
senses.glossTc: 取得、收到，或變成某種狀態。

examples.en: Can you get a spare roll for the till?
examples.tc: 你能取一卷備用收銀紙嗎？

examples.en: I get off at Mong Kok and walk to the shop.
examples.tc: 我在旺角下車，再步行到店。

examples.en: We need to get approval before Friday.
examples.tc: 我們要在星期五前取得審批。

senses.glossEn: To discover something after looking or by chance.
senses.glossTc: 經尋找或偶然發現某事物。

examples.en: I cannot find the spare till key.
examples.tc: 我找不到備用收銀鎖匙。

examples.en: Did you find a seat on the MTR?
examples.tc: 你在港鐵找到座位嗎？

examples.en: We found the missing invoice in WhatsApp files.
examples.tc: 我們在 WhatsApp 檔案找到那張遺失的發票。

synonyms.difference: Locate is more formal and often used for a place or file.

senses.glossEn: To require something because it is necessary.
senses.glossTc: 因為有必要而需要某事物。

examples.en: We need more coins in the till.
examples.tc: 收銀機需要多些硬幣。

examples.en: I need to leave before the last MTR.
examples.tc: 我要在尾班港鐵前離開。

examples.en: Do you need a bag for this?
examples.tc: 這個需要袋子嗎？

senses.glossEn: To wish to have or do something.
senses.glossTc: 想得到或想做某事。

examples.en: The customer wants a smaller size.
examples.tc: 顧客想要細一碼。

examples.en: I want to finish this before the meeting.
examples.tc: 我想在會議前做完這件事。

examples.en: Do you want the receipt in WhatsApp?
examples.tc: 你想把收據傳到 WhatsApp 嗎？

senses.glossEn: To have information in your mind.
senses.glossTc: 心中已有某項資料或認知。

examples.en: Do you know the supplier's pickup time?
examples.tc: 你知道供應商的取貨時間嗎？

examples.en: I know the till code; I will open it.
examples.tc: 我知道收銀密碼，我來開。

examples.en: Let me know when you reach the MTR.
examples.tc: 你到港鐵時告訴我。

senses.glossEn: To use your mind to consider an idea or opinion.
senses.glossTc: 用頭腦考慮想法或意見。

examples.en: I think we should open a second till.
examples.tc: 我認為應開第二部收銀機。

examples.en: Think about the deadline before you promise.
examples.tc: 答應之前先想想截止日期。

examples.en: She thought the WhatsApp was from a customer.
examples.tc: 她以為那則 WhatsApp 是顧客發的。

senses.glossEn: To keep a fact in your mind, or bring it back.
senses.glossTc: 把事情記在腦中，或重新想起。

examples.en: Remember to lock the till drawer.
examples.tc: 記得鎖好收銀錢箱。

examples.en: I cannot remember the supplier's stall number.
examples.tc: 我想不起供應商的檔位號碼。

examples.en: Remember the meeting is after the MTR peak.
examples.tc: 記得會議在港鐵高峰過後。

synonyms.difference: Recall is more formal and often means bring a memory back.

senses.glossEn: To fail to remember.
senses.glossTc: 未能記起。

examples.en: Do not forget the till report tonight.
examples.tc: 今晚不要忘記收銀報告。

examples.en: I forgot my Octopus at home.
examples.tc: 我把八達通留在家裏。

examples.en: She forgot to confirm on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 她忘了在 WhatsApp 確認。

senses.glossEn: To take something with you to a place.
senses.glossTc: 把東西帶到某地。

examples.en: Please bring the spare bags to the till.
examples.tc: 請把備用袋子帶到收銀處。

examples.en: I will bring lunch from the MTR exit stall.
examples.tc: 我會在港鐵出口檔攤帶午餐回來。

examples.en: Bring the invoice copy to the meeting.
examples.tc: 把發票副本帶到會議。

senses.glossEn: To hold something and move with it.
senses.glossTc: 拿着東西並移動。

examples.en: Can you carry this box to the stockroom?
examples.tc: 你能把這個箱子拿到貨倉嗎？

examples.en: I carry a spare till roll in my bag.
examples.tc: 我袋裏帶着備用收銀紙。

examples.en: Do not carry hot drinks onto the crowded MTR.
examples.tc: 不要把熱飲帶上擠迫的港鐵。

senses.glossEn: To put food in your mouth and swallow it.
senses.glossTc: 把食物放入口中吞下。

examples.en: We eat lunch after the morning queue dies down.
examples.tc: 上午排隊散去後我們才吃午餐。

examples.en: I ate a boxed rice near the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵附近吃了盒飯。

examples.en: Please do not eat behind the till.
examples.tc: 請不要在收銀處後面進食。

senses.glossEn: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
senses.glossTc: 把液體送入口中吞下。

examples.en: Drink some water before the long meeting.
examples.tc: 開長會前先喝點水。

examples.en: I drank tea on the MTR platform.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵月台喝茶。

examples.en: Customers may drink at the side counter, not the till.
examples.tc: 顧客可在側櫃位飲用，不要在收銀處喝。

senses.glossEn: To rest with your body on a seat.
senses.glossTc: 坐在座位上。

examples.en: Please sit while I check the size in the stockroom.
examples.tc: 請先坐下，我去貨倉查尺碼。

examples.en: I sat on the MTR and answered WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 我坐在港鐵上回 WhatsApp。

examples.en: There is nowhere to sit during the supplier meeting.
examples.tc: 供應商會議期間沒有座位。

senses.glossEn: To be on your feet, not sitting.
senses.glossTc: 站着，不是坐着。

examples.en: Please stand behind the yellow line at the till.
examples.tc: 請在收銀處黃線後站着。

examples.en: I stood on the MTR all the way to Central.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上一直站到中環。

examples.en: The security guard stood by the door during the queue.
examples.tc: 排隊期間保安站在門口。

senses.glossEn: To turn your eyes toward something.
senses.glossTc: 把視線轉向某物。

examples.en: Look at the till screen before you tap Octopus.
examples.tc: 拍八達通前先看收銀機螢幕。

examples.en: I looked for the supplier at the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵出口找供應商。

examples.en: Please look at this WhatsApp photo of the damage.
examples.tc: 請看這張 WhatsApp 損壞相片。

senses.glossEn: To pay attention to sounds or spoken words.
senses.glossTc: 留心聽聲音或說話。

examples.en: Listen to the customer before you offer a refund.
examples.tc: 提出退款前，先聽顧客說。

examples.en: I listen to the meeting notes on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上聽會議錄音。

examples.en: Please listen for the till beep.
examples.tc: 請留意收銀機的提示聲。

senses.glossEn: To say words; to talk.
senses.glossTc: 說出話語；交談。

examples.en: Can you speak to the supplier this afternoon?
examples.tc: 你今天下午能跟供應商談嗎？

examples.en: Please speak slowly; the till area is noisy.
examples.tc: 請說慢一點，收銀處很嘈。

examples.en: I will speak English with the tourist at the counter.
examples.tc: 我會用英語跟櫃位的旅客說話。

synonyms.difference: Talk is more informal. Speak is common with languages and formal contact.

senses.glossEn: To put words on paper or in a message.
senses.glossTc: 把文字寫在紙上或訊息裏。

examples.en: Write the pickup name on the bag.
examples.tc: 把取貨姓名寫在袋子上。

examples.en: I wrote the deadline in the WhatsApp group.
examples.tc: 我把截止日期寫在 WhatsApp 群組。

examples.en: Please write a short note for the next till shift.
examples.tc: 請為下一更收銀寫一則短訊。

senses.glossEn: To make an effort to do something.
senses.glossTc: 嘗試做某事。

examples.en: Try the other till if this one is frozen.
examples.tc: 若這部收銀機當機，試試另一部。

examples.en: I will try to reach the shop before the MTR peak.
examples.tc: 我會盡量在港鐵高峰前到店。

examples.en: Please try a smaller size in the fitting room.
examples.tc: 請到試身室試細一碼。

senses.glossEn: To do a job with a tool, system, or method.
senses.glossTc: 用工具、系統或方法來做事。

examples.en: Use the handheld scanner at the till.
examples.tc: 在收銀處使用手提掃描器。

examples.en: I use WhatsApp for supplier updates.
examples.tc: 我用 WhatsApp 接收供應商最新情況。

examples.en: You can use Octopus on this gate.
examples.tc: 這個閘機可用八達通。

senses.glossEn: To continue to have something, or to make it stay in a state.
senses.glossTc: 繼續持有，或使某物保持某狀態。

examples.en: Keep the spare change in the till drawer.
examples.tc: 把備用零錢放在收銀錢箱。

examples.en: Keep this WhatsApp thread for the complaint.
examples.tc: 保留這則 WhatsApp 對話作投訴紀錄。

examples.en: Please keep the receipt until you leave the MTR.
examples.tc: 離開港鐵前請保留收據。

senses.glossEn: To move something to a place.
senses.glossTc: 把東西放到某處。

examples.en: Put the returns box behind the till.
examples.tc: 把退貨箱放在收銀處後面。

examples.en: I put the keys in my bag before the MTR.
examples.tc: 上港鐵前我把鎖匙放進袋。

examples.en: Put the deadline on the whiteboard.
examples.tc: 把截止日期寫在白板上。

senses.glossEn: To let someone see something.
senses.glossTc: 讓對方看見某物。

examples.en: Show the customer the size chart.
examples.tc: 把尺碼表給顧客看。

examples.en: I will show you the till steps after lunch.
examples.tc: 午飯後我會示範收銀步驟。

examples.en: Show me the WhatsApp from the supplier.
examples.tc: 把供應商的 WhatsApp 給我看。

senses.glossEn: To let other people have or see the same thing.
senses.glossTc: 讓別人一同擁有或看見。

examples.en: Share the meeting notes in the group.
examples.tc: 把會議紀錄分享到群組。

examples.en: I shared the till password with the duty manager only.
examples.tc: 收銀密碼我只分享給當值經理。

examples.en: Can we share a taxi from the MTR?
examples.tc: 我們可以由港鐵共乘的士嗎？

senses.glossEn: To pick one thing from more than one option.
senses.glossTc: 從多個選擇中揀一個。

examples.en: Choose a bag size at the till.
examples.tc: 在收銀處揀袋子尺寸。

examples.en: I chose the later MTR to avoid the crush.
examples.tc: 我選了較後的港鐵，避開擠迫。

examples.en: Please choose a delivery slot in WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 請在 WhatsApp 揀送貨時段。

synonyms.difference: Select is more formal and common on screens and forms.

senses.glossEn: To make a choice after thinking.
senses.glossTc: 經考慮後作出選擇。

examples.en: We must decide the opening hours this week.
examples.tc: 我們本週必須決定營業時間。

examples.en: I decided to take the MTR instead of a taxi.
examples.tc: 我決定乘港鐵，不坐的士。

examples.en: Decide the refund at the till, then log it.
examples.tc: 在收銀處決定退款，然後記錄。

senses.glossEn: To make something different, or to become different.
senses.glossTc: 使某事物不同，或本身變得不同。

examples.en: Please change the till roll; it is nearly finished.
examples.tc: 請更換收銀紙，快用完了。

examples.en: I changed trains at Admiralty.
examples.tc: 我在金鐘轉車。

examples.en: We changed the WhatsApp greeting after the complaint.
examples.tc: 投訴後我們改了 WhatsApp 問候語。

senses.glossEn: To begin doing something.
senses.glossTc: 開始做某事。

examples.en: We start the till count at nine.
examples.tc: 我們九時開始清點收銀。

examples.en: The meeting starts after I get off the MTR.
examples.tc: 我下港鐵後會議才開始。

examples.en: Start packing while the customer pays.
examples.tc: 顧客付款時開始裝袋。

synonyms.difference: Begin is a little more formal. Start is the everyday word.

senses.glossEn: To not continue; to make something not continue.
senses.glossTc: 停止；使某事不再繼續。

examples.en: Stop the queue at the door if the shop is full.
examples.tc: 若店內已滿，請在門口停止排隊進入。

examples.en: The MTR stopped between stations for two minutes.
examples.tc: 港鐵在站與站之間停了兩分鐘。

examples.en: Please stop the till update until closing.
examples.tc: 請待關門後才停止／暫停收銀更新。

senses.glossEn: To complete something so it is done.
senses.glossTc: 完成某事。

examples.en: Finish the stock count before you open.
examples.tc: 開店前先完成盤點。

examples.en: I finished the WhatsApp replies on the train.
examples.tc: 我在車上完成了 WhatsApp 回覆。

examples.en: We cannot finish the meeting without approval.
examples.tc: 未獲審批，會議無法完成。

synonyms.difference: Complete is more formal and often used for forms and projects.

senses.glossEn: To fail to catch, attend, or notice something.
senses.glossTc: 未能趕上、出席或注意到。

examples.en: If we miss this MTR, we miss the supplier.
examples.tc: 若趕不上這班港鐵，就見不到供應商。

examples.en: I missed the WhatsApp about the till fault.
examples.tc: 我漏看了收銀故障的 WhatsApp。

examples.en: Do not miss the deadline on the invoice.
examples.tc: 不要錯過發票上的截止日期。

senses.glossEn: To get on a bus or train in time, or to stop something moving.
senses.glossTc: 及時趕上巴士或火車，或截住移動的東西。

examples.en: I need to catch the 6:12 MTR.
examples.tc: 我要趕上六時十二分的港鐵。

examples.en: Catch me at the till after you pack.
examples.tc: 你裝完袋後到收銀處找我。

examples.en: We caught the courier before he left the shop.
examples.tc: 我們在速遞離開店舖前截到他。

senses.glossEn: To move or act faster than usual.
senses.glossTc: 比平時更快地行動。

examples.en: Hurry; the till queue is at the door.
examples.tc: 快點，收銀排隊已到門口。

examples.en: I hurried to the MTR after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後我趕去港鐵。

examples.en: Do not hurry the refund; check the receipt first.
examples.tc: 退款不要趕，先核對收據。

senses.glossEn: To stop work for a short time so you can recover.
senses.glossTc: 暫停工作片刻以恢復體力。

examples.en: Rest for five minutes after the lunch queue.
examples.tc: 午市排隊過後休息五分鐘。

examples.en: I rested on a bench outside the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵外的長椅休息。

examples.en: The night shift still needs a rest before stock take.
examples.tc: 夜更在盤點前仍需要休息。

senses.glossEn: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind not awake.
senses.glossTc: 閉上眼睛、意識暫停地休息。

examples.en: I sleep after I close the till report.
examples.tc: 我做完收銀報告才睡覺。

examples.en: Do not sleep through the supplier's morning call.
examples.tc: 不要睡過供應商早上的電話。

examples.en: She slept on the MTR and missed her station.
examples.tc: 她在港鐵上睡着，坐過站。

senses.glossEn: To stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping.
senses.glossTc: 停止睡眠，或喚醒別人。

examples.en: I wake at six to open the shop.
examples.tc: 我六時起床開店。

examples.en: Wake me if the WhatsApp from the courier arrives.
examples.tc: 若速遞的 WhatsApp 到了，請叫醒我。

examples.en: The till alarm woke the night staff.
examples.tc: 收銀機警報吵醒了夜更同事。

senses.glossEn: A place where goods are sold to customers.
senses.glossTc: 向顧客出售貨品的地方。

examples.en: The shop next to the MTR closes at ten.
examples.tc: 港鐵旁邊那間店十時關門。

examples.en: Keep the shop floor clear of boxes.
examples.tc: 不要讓紙箱擋住店舖通道。

examples.en: I walked from the shop to the supplier meeting.
examples.tc: 我由店舖步行去供應商會議。

synonyms.difference: Store is common in American English. Shop is the usual Hong Kong word.

senses.glossEn: A public road in a town, often with shops.
senses.glossTc: 市鎮裏的公用道路，兩旁常有店舖。

examples.en: The delivery van cannot stop on this street.
examples.tc: 送貨車不能在這條街停車。

examples.en: There is a long queue in the street at lunch.
examples.tc: 午飯時街上排隊很長。

examples.en: Walk up the street from the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 由港鐵出口沿街向上走。

senses.glossEn: A place where trains or buses stop for people.
senses.glossTc: 火車或巴士停靠、供人上落的地方。

examples.en: Meet me at the station gate after work.
examples.tc: 下班後在車站閘口等我。

examples.en: The supplier left the boxes at the station office.
examples.tc: 供應商把箱子留在車站辦事處。

examples.en: This station is two stops from the shop.
examples.tc: 此站距離店舖兩站。

senses.glossEn: A small document that lets you travel or enter.
senses.glossTc: 讓你乘車或入場的小票。

examples.en: I bought an MTR ticket because my Octopus had no value.
examples.tc: 八達通沒有餘額，我買了港鐵車票。

examples.en: Show the ticket QR at the till for the event.
examples.tc: 在收銀處出示活動門票二維碼。

examples.en: Keep your ticket until you leave the station.
examples.tc: 離開車站前請保留車票。

senses.glossEn: A container made of paper, plastic, or cloth for carrying things.
senses.glossTc: 用紙、塑膠或布做成、用來攜帶物品的袋子。

examples.en: Would you like a bag for this?
examples.tc: 這個需要袋子嗎？

examples.en: Put the spare bags under the till.
examples.tc: 把備用袋子放在收銀處下面。

examples.en: My bag was too full on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上袋子太滿。

senses.glossEn: Coins and notes used to pay for things.
senses.glossTc: 用來付款的硬幣和紙幣。

examples.en: Count the money in the till after closing.
examples.tc: 關門後清點收銀機裏的金錢。

examples.en: I did not bring enough money for a taxi.
examples.tc: 我沒帶夠錢坐的士。

examples.en: Put the supplier's money in a separate envelope.
examples.tc: 把付給供應商的錢另放信封。

senses.glossEn: Money in coins and notes, not a card transfer.
senses.glossTc: 硬幣和紙幣，不是卡或轉帳。

examples.en: We still take cash at this till.
examples.tc: 這個收銀處仍收現金。

examples.en: I need cash for the wet-market supplier.
examples.tc: 我需要現金付給街市供應商。

examples.en: Do not leave cash on the counter.
examples.tc: 不要把現金留在櫃台上。

senses.glossEn: A plastic bank card or membership card used to pay or identify.
senses.glossTc: 用來付款或證明身分的塑膠卡或會員卡。

examples.en: Tap your card on the till reader.
examples.tc: 把卡在收銀機感應器上輕拍。

examples.en: My Octopus card needs more value.
examples.tc: 我的八達通要增值。

examples.en: The customer left a loyalty card at the counter.
examples.tc: 顧客把會員卡留在櫃位。

senses.glossEn: A mobile device used to call, message, and pay.
senses.glossTc: 用來通話、發訊息和付款的手提裝置。

examples.en: Charge your phone before the long meeting.
examples.tc: 開長會前先為手機充電。

examples.en: The till can take phone payments.
examples.tc: 收銀機可接受手機付款。

examples.en: I dropped my phone on the MTR and the case saved it.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵掉了手機，保護套保住了它。

senses.glossEn: A short piece of writing sent to someone.
senses.glossTc: 發給對方的短訊文字。

examples.en: I sent a message when the supplier arrived.
examples.tc: 供應商到達時我發了訊息。

examples.en: Check the WhatsApp message before you open the till.
examples.tc: 開收銀機前先看 WhatsApp 訊息。

examples.en: The customer left a message about the queue.
examples.tc: 顧客留了有關排隊的訊息。

senses.glossEn: A written message sent through the internet.
senses.glossTc: 經互聯網傳送的書面訊息。

examples.en: The invoice is in this morning's email.
examples.tc: 發票在今早的電郵裏。

examples.en: I read the email on the MTR but will reply at the shop.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上看了電郵，會到店才回覆。

examples.en: Please put the till fault in an email, not only WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 請把收銀故障寫進電郵，不要只發 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: A person you know well and like.
senses.glossTc: 你熟悉並喜歡的人。

examples.en: A friend will cover the till on Sunday.
examples.tc: 一位朋友星期日會頂收銀。

examples.en: I met a school friend on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵遇見舊同學。

examples.en: My friend sent the supplier contact on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 我朋友用 WhatsApp 把供應商聯絡寄來。

senses.glossEn: People related to you, such as parents or children.
senses.glossTc: 與你有親屬關係的人，例如父母或子女。

examples.en: My family eats near the shop on Saturdays.
examples.tc: 星期六我家人在店舖附近吃飯。

examples.en: I call my family after I close the till.
examples.tc: 關收銀機後我會打電話給家人。

examples.en: Family visitors should wait outside the stockroom.
examples.tc: 探店的家人請在貨倉外等候。

senses.glossEn: The place where you live.
senses.glossTc: 你居住的地方。

examples.en: I work on the file at home after the shop closes.
examples.tc: 店舖關門後我在家處理檔案。

examples.en: Go home if the MTR is still running.
examples.tc: 若港鐵仍開，就回家吧。

examples.en: We sent the spare till roll home by mistake.
examples.tc: 我們誤把備用收銀紙寄回家。

senses.glossEn: A room or building where people do desk work.
senses.glossTc: 人們做文書工作的房間或大樓。

examples.en: The accounts office needs the till report.
examples.tc: 會計辦公室需要收銀報告。

examples.en: I will print this at the office near the MTR.
examples.tc: 我會在港鐵附近的辦公室列印。

examples.en: Meet the supplier at our small office upstairs.
examples.tc: 在樓上小辦公室見供應商。

senses.glossEn: The meal you eat in the middle of the day.
senses.glossTc: 中午吃的一餐。

examples.en: The lunch queue starts at twelve.
examples.tc: 午市排隊十二時開始。

examples.en: I ate lunch on a bench after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後我在長椅吃午餐。

examples.en: Cover the till while I take lunch.
examples.tc: 我去吃午餐時請看收銀。

senses.glossEn: A hot drink made from coffee beans.
senses.glossTc: 用咖啡豆沖的熱飲。

examples.en: Grab a coffee after we close the till.
examples.tc: 關收銀機後去買杯咖啡。

examples.en: The supplier meeting ran long, so I bought coffee at the MTR.
examples.tc: 供應商會議很長，我在港鐵買了咖啡。

examples.en: Do not put coffee next to the till keyboard.
examples.tc: 不要把咖啡放在收銀鍵盤旁邊。

senses.glossEn: A hot drink made by pouring water on tea leaves.
senses.glossTc: 用熱水沖茶葉的熱飲。

examples.en: Would you like tea while you wait for the fitting room?
examples.tc: 等試身室時要喝茶嗎？

examples.en: I bought milk tea after I left the MTR.
examples.tc: 出港鐵後我買了奶茶。

examples.en: Bring tea to the back room after the rush.
examples.tc: 繁忙過後把茶帶到後倉。

senses.glossEn: The clear liquid you drink and use for cleaning.
senses.glossTc: 用來飲用和清潔的透明液體。

examples.en: Keep bottled water under the till for staff.
examples.tc: 在收銀處下放樽裝水給同事。

examples.en: I bought water on the MTR platform.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵月台買了水。

examples.en: Wipe the counter with clean water after the spill.
examples.tc: 濺濕後用清水抹櫃位。

senses.glossEn: Things people eat.
senses.glossTc: 人們吃的東西。

examples.en: Do not leave food beside the till scanner.
examples.tc: 不要把食物留在收銀掃描器旁邊。

examples.en: The stall food near the MTR is fast.
examples.tc: 港鐵附近檔攤的食物很快。

examples.en: We packed spare food for the late meeting.
examples.tc: 我們為開晚會準備了備用食物。

senses.glossEn: How big or small something is, especially clothes.
senses.glossTc: 東西的大小，尤其指衣服尺碼。

examples.en: This size is too small; try the next one.
examples.tc: 這個尺碼太小，試大一碼。

examples.en: Check the size on the till before you pack.
examples.tc: 裝袋前先在收銀機核對尺碼。

examples.en: WhatsApp me the size if you are on the MTR.
examples.tc: 若你在港鐵上，用 WhatsApp 把尺碼傳給我。

senses.glossEn: Red, blue, green, and other looks of a surface.
senses.glossTc: 紅、藍、綠等表面外觀。

examples.en: We only have this colour left in stock.
examples.tc: 存貨只剩這個顏色。

examples.en: The customer asked for a darker colour at the till.
examples.tc: 顧客在收銀處要求深一點的顏色。

examples.en: Send a colour photo on WhatsApp before we reorder.
examples.tc: 再訂貨前用 WhatsApp 傳一張顏色相片。

senses.glossEn: A period of seven days.
senses.glossTc: 七天的一段時間。

examples.en: This week the shop closes one hour earlier.
examples.tc: 本週店舖提早一小時關門。

examples.en: I have two supplier meetings this week.
examples.tc: 我本週有兩個供應商會議。

examples.en: Next week the till software will change.
examples.tc: 下週收銀軟件會更換。

senses.glossEn: One of the twelve parts of a year.
senses.glossTc: 一年之中的十二份之一。

examples.en: Rent is due at the start of the month.
examples.tc: 租金在月初到期。

examples.en: This month the queue is longer at lunch.
examples.tc: 本月午市排隊較長。

examples.en: We review cash flow every month.
examples.tc: 我們每月檢視現金流。

senses.glossEn: A period of twelve months.
senses.glossTc: 十二個月的一段時間。

examples.en: The shop has been here for three years.
examples.tc: 這間店已在這裏三年。

examples.en: I renew the business licence every year.
examples.tc: 我每年續商業登記。

examples.en: Next year we may add a second till.
examples.tc: 明年我們或會加第二部收銀機。

senses.glossEn: A period of sixty minutes.
senses.glossTc: 六十分鐘的一段時間。

examples.en: The meeting will take one hour.
examples.tc: 會議需時一小時。

examples.en: I need an hour to close the till.
examples.tc: 我需要一小時關收銀機。

examples.en: The MTR ride is half an hour.
examples.tc: 港鐵車程半小時。

senses.glossEn: A period of sixty seconds.
senses.glossTc: 六十秒的一段時間。

examples.en: The till will restart in two minutes.
examples.tc: 收銀機兩分鐘後會重啟。

examples.en: Wait a minute; I am on WhatsApp with the supplier.
examples.tc: 請等一分鐘，我正在跟供應商 WhatsApp。

examples.en: The MTR is one minute away.
examples.tc: 港鐵還有一分鐘到。

senses.glossEn: The part of the day before noon.
senses.glossTc: 中午之前的時段。

examples.en: The morning delivery arrives before we open.
examples.tc: 早班送貨在我們開店前到達。

examples.en: I read the WhatsApp list every morning on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我每天早上在港鐵上看 WhatsApp 清單。

examples.en: Morning queues are shorter than lunch queues.
examples.tc: 早上排隊比午市短。

senses.glossEn: The part of the day from noon until evening.
senses.glossTc: 由中午到傍晚的時段。

examples.en: The supplier meeting is this afternoon.
examples.tc: 供應商會議在今天下午。

examples.en: Afternoons are quiet at the till.
examples.tc: 下午收銀處較清靜。

examples.en: I will confirm on WhatsApp this afternoon.
examples.tc: 我今天下午會用 WhatsApp 確認。

senses.glossEn: The part of the day after work and before night.
senses.glossTc: 下班後到夜晚前的時段。

examples.en: We count the till every evening.
examples.tc: 我們每天晚上清點收銀。

examples.tc: 晚上港鐵很擠。

examples.en: I send the daily update in the evening.
examples.tc: 我在傍晚寄出每日最新情況。

senses.glossEn: The dark part of the day when many people sleep.
senses.glossTc: 一天之中天黑、許多人睡覺的時段。

examples.en: The night shift closes the shop.
examples.tc: 夜更負責關門。

examples.en: I got the WhatsApp at night and replied in the morning.
examples.tc: 我晚上收到 WhatsApp，早上才回。

examples.en: There is no MTR late at night, so take a taxi.
examples.tc: 深夜沒有港鐵，請坐的士。

senses.glossEn: Saturday and Sunday, when many people do not work.
senses.glossTc: 星期六和星期日，許多人不用上班。

examples.en: Weekend queues start before we open.
examples.tc: 週末我們未開店已有排隊。

examples.en: I work this weekend and rest on Monday.
examples.tc: 我這個週末上班，星期一休息。

examples.en: Send the weekend roster in WhatsApp tonight.
examples.tc: 今晚用 WhatsApp 把週末更表寄出。

senses.glossEn: Rain, heat, wind, and other outdoor conditions.
senses.glossTc: 雨、熱、風等戶外情況。

examples.en: Bad weather cut the street queue today.
examples.tc: 今天天氣差，街上排隊少了。

examples.tc: 天氣令供應商貨車延誤。

examples.en: Check the weather before you walk from the MTR.

senses.glossEn: Water that falls from the sky in drops.
senses.glossTc: 由天空落下的水滴。

examples.tc: 雨水令顧客留在港鐵出口底下。

examples.tc: 在收銀處附近放袋子給濕傘。

examples.en: Heavy rain delayed the evening delivery.
examples.tc: 大雨令晚上送貨延誤。

senses.glossEn: A set of railway carriages that people ride, including the MTR.
senses.glossTc: 供人乘坐的一組鐵路車卡，包括港鐵。

examples.en: The next train is in three minutes.
examples.tc: 下班車三分鐘後到。

examples.tc: 上車前我先裝好樣本。

examples.en: This train is too crowded to take a supplier call.
examples.tc: 這班車太擠，不適合打給供應商。

senses.glossEn: A large road vehicle that carries many passengers.
senses.glossTc: 載許多乘客的大型道路車輛。

examples.en: Take the bus if the MTR is delayed.

examples.tc: 巴士站在店舖外面。

examples.tc: 關門後我在巴士上回 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: A car you pay to ride to a place.
senses.glossTc: 付錢乘坐、載你到某地的汽車。

examples.tc: 若趕不上尾班港鐵，就坐的士。

examples.tc: 供應商坐的士帶樣本來。

examples.en: Keep the taxi receipt for the accounts file.
examples.tc: 保留的士收據作會計檔案。

senses.glossEn: A small public van with a short local route.
senses.glossTc: 行走短途路線的小型公共客車。

examples.tc: 綠色小巴在貨倉附近停。

examples.tc: 港鐵出口關閉時我改乘小巴。

examples.tc: 小巴可用現金或八達通付款。

senses.glossEn: A small case for cards and cash.
senses.glossTc: 放卡和現金的小包。

examples.tc: 我把錢包留在收銀處旁邊。

examples.en: Keep your Octopus in the wallet, not loose.
examples.tc: 把八達通放在錢包裏，不要散放。

examples.en: A customer found a wallet on the MTR and brought it in.
examples.tc: 有顧客在港鐵拾到錢包，拿到店來。

senses.glossEn: A small metal or card tool that opens a lock.
senses.glossTc: 用來開鎖的小金屬或卡片工具。

examples.tc: 收銀鎖匙掛在櫃位後面。

examples.en: Do not take the shop key on the MTR unless you are closing.
examples.tc: 除非你負責關門，否則不要把店舖鎖匙帶上港鐵。

examples.en: I messaged WhatsApp when I found the spare key.
examples.tc: 我找到備用鎖匙時發了 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: The moving panel that closes the entrance to a room or shop.
senses.glossTc: 關閉房間或店舖入口的活動門板。

examples.tc: 幫提着袋子的顧客扶着門。

examples.tc: 供應商離開後鎖好後門。

examples.en: The MTR door closed before I got on.
examples.tc: 我還未上車，港鐵車門已關上。

senses.glossEn: An opening in a wall, usually with glass.
senses.glossTc: 牆上的開口，通常有玻璃。

examples.en: Clean the shop window before we open.
examples.tc: 開店前先清潔櫥窗。

examples.en: The delivery note is on the office window.
examples.tc: 送貨單貼在辦公室玻璃窗。

examples.en: I stood by the train window and read WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 我站在車窗旁看 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: A piece of furniture with a flat top.
senses.glossTc: 有平面桌面的家具。

examples.en: Put the samples on the meeting table.
examples.tc: 把樣本放在會議桌上。

examples.en: The staff table is behind the till.
examples.tc: 員工枱在收銀處後面。

examples.en: I ate at a small table near the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵附近一張小枱吃飯。

senses.glossEn: A seat for one person.
senses.glossTc: 供一人坐的座位。

examples.en: There is a chair for customers waiting for alterations.
examples.tc: 有一張椅子給等候改衣的顧客。

examples.en: Bring an extra chair to the supplier meeting.
examples.tc: 供應商會議多搬一張椅子。

examples.en: I gave my chair to an older passenger on the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵把座位讓給較年長的乘客。

senses.glossEn: A box that carries people up and down in a building.
senses.glossTc: 在大廈裏載人上下的箱子。

examples.en: Take the lift to the fifth-floor stockroom.
examples.tc: 乘升降機到五樓貨倉。

examples.en: The lift is slow at lunch; use the stairs if you can.
examples.tc: 午飯時升降機很慢，可以的話行樓梯。

examples.en: Do not block the lift with delivery boxes.
examples.tc: 不要用送貨紙箱堵住升降機。

synonyms.difference: Elevator is American English. Lift is the usual Hong Kong word.

senses.glossEn: The surface you walk on, or a level of a building.
senses.glossTc: 行走的地面，或大廈的一層。

examples.en: Keep the floor dry near the till.
examples.tc: 收銀處附近的地面保持乾燥。

examples.en: The shop is on the second floor.
examples.tc: 店舖在二樓。

examples.en: Boxes on the floor will trip the queue.
examples.tc: 地上的箱子會絆到排隊的人。

senses.glossEn: A structure with walls and a roof, such as a mall or office block.
senses.glossTc: 有牆有頂的建築物，例如商場或寫字樓。

examples.en: The warehouse is in an industrial building in Kwun Tong.
examples.tc: 貨倉在觀塘一座工業大廈。

examples.en: This building closes the doors at midnight.
examples.tc: 這座大廈午夜關門。

examples.en: Meet the supplier in the building lobby.
examples.tc: 在大堂與供應商會面。

senses.glossEn: A hard route for cars, buses, and vans.
senses.glossTc: 供汽車、巴士和貨車行走的堅硬通道。

examples.en: The van cannot turn on this narrow road.
examples.tc: 貨車無法在這條窄路轉彎。

examples.en: Cross the road at the lights after the MTR.
examples.tc: 出港鐵後在燈位過路。

examples.en: Road works delayed the afternoon delivery.
examples.tc: 道路工程令下午送貨延誤。

senses.glossEn: A folding cover that keeps rain off you.
senses.glossTc: 可摺疊、用來擋雨的遮蓋物。

examples.en: Leave wet umbrellas in the stand by the door.
examples.tc: 把濕傘放在門口傘架。

examples.en: I bought a cheap umbrella outside the MTR.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵外買了一把便宜的傘。

examples.en: Do not open the umbrella inside the shop.
examples.tc: 不要在店內開傘。

senses.glossEn: A short coat you wear on the upper body.
senses.glossTc: 穿在上身的短外衣。

examples.en: Hang your jacket behind the till, not on the counter.
examples.tc: 外套掛在收銀後面，不要放櫃位。

examples.en: This jacket is the last one in that size.
examples.tc: 這件外套是該尺碼最後一件。

examples.en: I left my jacket on the MTR seat.
examples.tc: 我把外套留在港鐵座位。

senses.glossEn: Coverings you wear on your feet.
senses.glossTc: 穿在腳上的鞋。

examples.en: Try the shoes on the mat, not the shop floor.
examples.tc: 在地墊試鞋，不要在店舖地面試。

examples.en: My shoes got wet walking from the MTR.
examples.tc: 由港鐵步行過來，鞋子濕了。

examples.en: We do not keep spare shoes behind the till.
examples.tc: 收銀後面不存放備用鞋子。

senses.glossEn: Things you wear, such as shirts and trousers.
senses.glossTc: 你穿的衣物，例如襯衫和褲子。

examples.en: Fold the clothes before you put them back.
examples.tc: 放回前先摺好衣服。

examples.en: I changed clothes after the stockroom was dusty.
examples.tc: 貨倉很塵，我換了衣服。

examples.en: The customer asked if these clothes can be returned.
examples.tc: 顧客問這些衣服可否退貨。

senses.glossEn: A planned time to meet someone.
senses.glossTc: 預先約好見面的時間。

examples.en: I have a bank appointment after the shop opens.
examples.tc: 店舖開門後我有銀行預約。

examples.en: The supplier appointment is at two.
examples.tc: 供應商預約在兩時。

examples.en: Please book an appointment; walk-ins wait longer.
examples.tc: 請先預約，即場輪候會較久。

synonyms.difference: A booking often holds a table or room. An appointment is usually with a person.

senses.glossEn: A person who lives or works next to you.
senses.glossTc: 住在或在你旁邊工作的人。

examples.en: Our neighbour shop shares the corridor.
examples.tc: 隔壁店舖與我們共用走廊。

examples.en: A neighbour watched the queue while we restarted the till.
examples.tc: 重啟收銀機時，鄰居幫忙看排隊。

examples.en: Tell the neighbour if the delivery van will block the door.
examples.tc: 若送貨車會擋門，請告知鄰居。

senses.glossEn: The person or company that owns a shop or flat and collects rent.
senses.glossTc: 擁有店舖或單位並收取租金的人或公司。

examples.en: The landlord will inspect the shop on Monday.
examples.tc: 業主星期一會巡店。

examples.en: Email the landlord about the leaking window.
examples.tc: 就漏水窗戶發電郵給業主。

examples.en: We need landlord approval before we move the till.
examples.tc: 移動收銀機前需要業主審批。

senses.glossEn: Money paid to use a shop or home.
senses.glossTc: 為使用店舖或住所而付的金錢。

examples.en: Shop rent is due on the first.
examples.tc: 舖租在每月一日到期。

examples.en: High rent is why we watch weekend cash so closely.
examples.tc: 租金高，所以我們緊盯週末現金。

examples.en: The landlord raised the rent after the renovation.
examples.tc: 裝修後業主加租。

senses.glossTc: 有很多事情要做，或地方很擠。

examples.en: The till is busy from twelve to two.
examples.tc: 收銀處由十二時到兩時都很忙。

examples.en: I am too busy on the MTR to take a call.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上太忙，不方便聽電話。

examples.en: Saturday is our busiest day.
examples.tc: 星期六是我們最忙的一天。

senses.glossEn: Before the usual or expected time.
senses.glossTc: 比平常或預期更早。

examples.en: Come early if you want to avoid the queue.
examples.tc: 想避開排隊就早點來。

examples.en: The supplier van was early, before we opened.
examples.tc: 供應商貨車來得早，我們還未開店。

examples.en: I took an early MTR to print the invoices.
examples.tc: 我乘早班港鐵去列印發票。

senses.glossEn: After the usual or expected time.
senses.glossTc: 比平常或預期更遲。

examples.en: The delivery is late; tell the till team.
examples.tc: 送貨遲了，請告知收銀同事。

examples.en: I was late because the MTR stopped.
examples.tc: 港鐵停車，所以我遲到。

examples.en: A late WhatsApp is still better than no update.
examples.tc: 遲來的 WhatsApp 仍好過沒有最新情況。

senses.glossEn: Low in price.
senses.glossTc: 價錢低。

examples.en: This bag is cheap, but it tears easily.
examples.tc: 這個袋子便宜，但容易破。

examples.en: We found a cheaper supplier near the MTR.
examples.tc: 我們在港鐵附近找到較便宜的供應商。

examples.en: Cheap prices still need till approval if they are below cost.
examples.tc: 即使價錢便宜，低於成本仍要收銀審批。

synonyms.difference: Inexpensive sounds more polite. Cheap can also mean low quality.

senses.glossEn: High in price.
senses.glossTc: 價錢高。

examples.en: This jacket is more expensive than the last one.
examples.tc: 這件外套比上一件貴。

examples.en: Taxi is expensive after the last MTR.
examples.tc: 尾班港鐵後坐的士很貴。

examples.en: Explain why the item is expensive before the customer reaches the till.
examples.tc: 顧客到收銀前，先解釋為何這件貴。

senses.glossEn: Costing no money, or not busy.
senses.glossTc: 不用付錢，或並非繁忙。

examples.en: Gift wrap is free at this till today.
examples.tc: 今天這個收銀處免費包裝禮物。

examples.en: I am free after the supplier meeting.
examples.tc: 供應商會議後我有空。

examples.en: Is this sample free, or do we charge at the till?
examples.tc: 這件樣本免費，還是要在收銀處收費？

senses.glossEn: Holding as much as possible; no space left.
senses.glossTc: 已裝至最多；沒有空位。

examples.en: The till drawer is full of coins.
examples.tc: 收銀錢箱硬幣已滿。

examples.en: This MTR carriage is full; wait for the next.
examples.tc: 這卡已滿，等下一班。

examples.en: The WhatsApp group is full of weekend photos.
examples.tc: WhatsApp 群組充滿週末相片。

senses.glossEn: Containing nothing; not full.
senses.glossTc: 裏面沒有東西；不是滿的。

examples.en: The shelf is empty; restock from the back.
examples.tc: 貨架空了，從後面補貨。

examples.en: This bag is empty; put the receipt inside.
examples.tc: 這個袋子是空的，把收據放進去。

examples.en: The office is empty after seven.
examples.tc: 七時後辦公室沒人。

senses.glossEn: Not used or known before; recent.
senses.glossTc: 以前沒用過或不認識；新近的。

examples.en: The new till roll is in the drawer.
examples.tc: 新收銀紙在抽屜裏。

examples.en: A new staff member starts on Monday.
examples.tc: 新同事星期一上班。

examples.en: There is a new MTR exit closer to the shop.
examples.tc: 有一個新的港鐵出口較近店舖。

senses.glossEn: Having existed for a long time; not new.
senses.glossTc: 已存在很久；不是新的。

examples.en: The old till still works as backup.
examples.tc: 舊收銀機仍可作後備。

examples.en: This is an old WhatsApp; check the latest one.
examples.tc: 這是舊 WhatsApp，請看最新一則。

examples.en: The old landlord sold the building.
examples.tc: 舊業主把大廈賣了。

senses.glossEn: Little in size.
senses.glossTc: 尺寸小。

examples.en: We only have a small bag left.
examples.tc: 我們只剩小袋子。

examples.en: The stockroom is too small for these boxes.
examples.tc: 貨倉太小，放不下這些箱子。

examples.en: Write a small note for the next till shift.
examples.tc: 為下一更收銀寫一則短訊。

senses.glossEn: Big in size.
senses.glossTc: 尺寸大。

examples.en: Do you need a large bag?
examples.tc: 你需要大袋子嗎？

examples.en: The large box will not fit in the lift.
examples.tc: 大箱子放不進升降機。

examples.en: A large queue formed after the MTR arrived.
examples.tc: 港鐵到站後出現大排長龍。

senses.glossEn: Coming immediately after this one.
senses.glossTc: 緊接在這個之後的。

examples.en: Next customer, please.
examples.tc: 下一位顧客，請。

examples.en: The next meeting is on Thursday.
examples.tc: 下次會議在星期四。

examples.en: I will take the next MTR.
examples.tc: 我會乘下一班港鐵。

senses.glossEn: Coming after all others; most recent.
senses.glossTc: 在所有之後的；最近一次的。

examples.en: The last train is at midnight.
examples.tc: 尾班車在午夜。

examples.en: Last week the till froze twice.
examples.tc: 上週收銀機當了兩次。

examples.en: This is the last size on the shelf.
examples.tc: 這是貨架上最後一個尺碼。

senses.glossEn: Coming before all others.
senses.glossTc: 在所有之前的。

examples.en: First, count the till; then lock the door.
examples.tc: 先清點收銀，再鎖門。

examples.en: This is my first week in the shop.
examples.tc: 這是我在店舖的第一週。

examples.en: The first delivery arrives before nine.
examples.tc: 第一班送貨九時前到。

senses.glossEn: Prepared and able to start.
senses.glossTc: 已準備好，可以開始。

examples.en: The order is ready for pickup at the till.
examples.tc: 訂單已在收銀處準備好可取。

examples.en: Are you ready for the supplier meeting?
examples.tc: 你準備好開供應商會議嗎？

examples.en: I will be ready when the MTR reaches Admiralty.
examples.tc: 港鐵到金鐘時我就準備好。

senses.glossEn: Confident that something is true.
senses.glossTc: 有信心某事屬實。

examples.en: Are you sure this is the right size?
examples.tc: 你確定這是正確尺碼嗎？

examples.en: I am sure the WhatsApp came from the supplier.
examples.tc: 我肯定那則 WhatsApp 來自供應商。

examples.en: Make sure the till is locked.
examples.tc: 確保收銀機已鎖。

senses.glossEn: High in temperature.
senses.glossTc: 溫度高。

examples.en: The stockroom is hot; drink water.
examples.tc: 貨倉很熱，請喝水。

examples.en: This soup is hot; hold the bag at the bottom.
examples.tc: 這碗湯很熱，托着袋底。

examples.en: It was too hot to queue outside.
examples.tc: 外面太熱，不適合排隊。

senses.glossEn: Low in temperature.
senses.glossTc: 溫度低。

examples.en: Keep the drinks cold in the back fridge.
examples.tc: 飲料放後倉雪櫃保持凍。

examples.en: It is cold on the MTR platform tonight.
examples.tc: 今晚港鐵月台很冷。

examples.en: The customer said the dumplings arrived cold.
examples.tc: 顧客說餃子送到時已經凍。

senses.glossEn: Covered or soaked with water.
senses.glossTc: 被水覆蓋或浸透。

examples.en: The floor is wet near the door.
examples.tc: 門口附近地面濕。

examples.en: My bag got wet on the walk from the MTR.
examples.tc: 由港鐵步行過來，袋子濕了。

examples.en: Do not put wet umbrellas on the till counter.
examples.tc: 不要把濕傘放在收銀櫃台上。

senses.glossEn: Not wet; without water.
senses.glossTc: 不濕；沒有水。

examples.en: Keep the till area dry.
examples.tc: 保持收銀範圍乾燥。

examples.en: Hang the jacket until it is dry.
examples.tc: 把外套掛到乾透。

examples.en: The stockroom must stay dry during the typhoon.
examples.tc: 颱風期間貨倉必須保持乾燥。

senses.glossEn: Needing rest because you have worked or not slept.
senses.glossTc: 因為工作或睡眠不足而需要休息。

examples.en: I am tired after the weekend queue.
examples.tc: 週末排隊過後我很累。

examples.en: Tired staff should not close the till alone.
examples.tc: 疲倦的同事不應獨自關收銀機。

examples.en: I felt tired on the MTR and almost missed my stop.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上很累，差點坐過站。

senses.glossEn: Wanting food.
senses.glossTc: 想吃東西。

examples.en: I get hungry if the lunch queue never ends.
examples.tc: 若午市排隊沒完，我會肚餓。

examples.en: The staff are hungry; send someone for rice.
examples.tc: 同事餓了，派人去買飯。

examples.en: I was hungry on the MTR and bought a bun.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵上肚餓，買了麵包。

senses.glossEn: Easy to use or easy to reach.
senses.glossTc: 方便使用或容易到達。

examples.en: The MTR exit makes this shop convenient.
examples.tc: 港鐵出口令這間店很方便。

examples.en: WhatsApp orders are convenient for regular customers.
examples.tc: 對熟客來說，WhatsApp 訂貨很方便。

examples.en: A second till is more convenient at lunch.
examples.tc: 午市開第二部收銀機會更方便。

senses.glossEn: Filled with too many people.
senses.glossTc: 擠滿太多人。

examples.en: The shop is crowded after the MTR arrives.
examples.tc: 港鐵到站後店舖很擠。

examples.en: This carriage is too crowded to take a call.
examples.tc: 這卡太擠，不適合聽電話。

examples.en: A crowded till needs a second cashier.
examples.tc: 收銀處擠迫時需要第二位收銀員。

senses.glossEn: With little noise or few people.
senses.glossTc: 聲音少，或人不多。

examples.en: The shop is quiet after two.
examples.tc: 兩時後店舖很靜。

examples.en: Find a quiet place to take the supplier call.
examples.tc: 找個安靜地方接供應商電話。

examples.en: Evenings are quiet except before the last MTR.
examples.tc: 除了尾班港鐵前，晚上都較清靜。

senses.glossEn: Making a lot of sound.
senses.glossTc: 發出很多聲音。

examples.en: The till area is noisy at lunch.
examples.tc: 午市收銀處很嘈。

examples.en: It is too noisy on the MTR to hear WhatsApp voice notes.
examples.tc: 港鐵太嘈，聽不清 WhatsApp 語音。

examples.en: A noisy fridge is bothering customers near the door.
examples.tc: 嘈吵的雪櫃騷擾門口附近的顧客。

senses.glossEn: Able to be used or free to help.
senses.glossTc: 可以使用，或有空幫忙。

examples.en: This size is not available until Friday.
examples.tc: 這個尺碼星期五才有貨。

examples.en: I am available after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後我有空。

examples.en: Ask if a manager is available for the refund.
examples.tc: 問問是否有經理可處理退款。

senses.glossEn: Not open for business, or shut.
senses.glossTc: 不營業，或已關上。

examples.en: The shop is closed on Tuesday.
examples.tc: 店舖星期二休息。

examples.en: This till is closed; please use the next one.
examples.tc: 這個收銀處已關閉，請用下一個。

examples.en: The MTR exit was closed, so we walked further.
examples.tc: 港鐵出口關閉，我們要走遠一點。

senses.glossEn: Not shut; ready for customers.
senses.glossTc: 沒有關上；準備好接待顧客。

examples.en: Are you still open?
examples.tc: 你們還開着嗎？

examples.en: The other till is open if this one is slow.
examples.tc: 若這個慢，另一部收銀機是開着的。

examples.en: Keep the back door open for the supplier van.
examples.tc: 為供應商貨車把後門保持打開。

senses.glossEn: In addition; too.
senses.glossTc: 另外；也。

examples.en: Please check the till, and also the spare drawer.
examples.tc: 請檢查收銀機，也檢查備用錢箱。

examples.en: I also need the WhatsApp from this morning.
examples.tc: 我也需要今早那則 WhatsApp。

examples.en: The shop is near the MTR and also near the bus stop.
examples.tc: 店舖近港鐵，也近巴士站。

senses.glossEn: Continuing up to now.
senses.glossTc: 直到現在仍在繼續。

examples.en: The customer is still in the queue.
examples.tc: 顧客仍在排隊。

examples.en: I am still on the MTR; start without me.
examples.tc: 我還在港鐵上，你們先開始。

examples.en: We still have that size in the stockroom.
examples.tc: 貨倉仍有那個尺碼。

senses.glossEn: Before now; sooner than expected.
senses.glossTc: 在現在之前；比預期早。

examples.en: The till report is already printed.
examples.tc: 收銀報告已經列印。

examples.en: I already confirmed on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 我已在 WhatsApp 確認。

examples.en: The supplier has already left the building.
examples.tc: 供應商已離開大廈。

senses.glossEn: Until now, in questions and negatives.
senses.glossTc: 直到現在（用於問句和否定句）。

examples.en: Has the delivery arrived yet?
examples.tc: 送貨到了沒有？

examples.en: I have not closed the till yet.
examples.tc: 我還未關收銀機。

examples.en: The meeting has not started yet; I am still on the MTR.
examples.tc: 會議還未開始，我還在港鐵。

senses.glossEn: One more time.
senses.glossTc: 再一次。

examples.en: Please try the card again.
examples.tc: 請再試一次卡。

examples.en: The till froze again after lunch.
examples.tc: 午飯後收銀機又當機。

examples.en: Say that again; the MTR was noisy.
examples.tc: 請再說一次，港鐵很嘈。

senses.glossEn: In this place.
senses.glossTc: 在這個地方。

examples.en: Please wait here.
examples.tc: 請在這裏等候。

examples.en: The spare bags are here under the till.
examples.tc: 備用袋子在收銀處下面這裏。

examples.en: I am here at the MTR exit.
examples.tc: 我在港鐵出口這裏。

senses.glossEn: In that place.
senses.glossTc: 在那個地方。

examples.en: The stockroom is over there.
examples.tc: 貨倉在那邊。

examples.en: I will meet you there after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後我在那裏與你會合。

examples.en: Leave the umbrella there by the door.
examples.tc: 把傘留在門口那裏。

senses.glossEn: At this moment.
senses.glossTc: 在這一刻。

examples.en: The next till is opening now.
examples.tc: 下一個收銀處現正開放。

examples.en: I am on the MTR now; I will be ten minutes late.
examples.tc: 我現在在港鐵上，會遲到十分鐘。

examples.en: Update the price now, before the queue grows.
examples.tc: 現在更新價錢，以免排隊變長。

senses.glossEn: In a short time from now.
senses.glossTc: 在短時間內。

examples.en: The supplier will arrive soon.
examples.tc: 供應商快到。

examples.en: I will reach the shop soon; the MTR is moving.
examples.tc: 我快到店，港鐵正在行駛。

examples.en: We will open a second till soon.
examples.tc: 我們快會開第二部收銀機。

senses.glossEn: At a time after now.
senses.glossTc: 在現在之後的時間。

examples.en: I will count the till later.
examples.tc: 我稍後才清點收銀。

examples.en: Message me later when you leave the MTR.
examples.tc: 你離開港鐵後稍後發訊息給我。

examples.en: We can talk later; the customer is waiting.
examples.tc: 我們稍後再談，顧客在等。

senses.glossEn: At a fast speed.
senses.glossTc: 以快的速度。

examples.en: Pack quickly; the queue is long.
examples.tc: 快點裝袋，排隊很長。

examples.en: I walked quickly from the MTR in the rain.
examples.tc: 我冒雨由港鐵快走過來。

examples.en: Please reply quickly on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 請盡快在 WhatsApp 回覆。

senses.glossEn: At a low speed.
senses.glossTc: 以慢的速度。

examples.en: Speak slowly so the tourist can follow.
examples.tc: 說慢一點，讓旅客聽得明。

examples.en: The till is printing slowly.
examples.tc: 收銀機列印很慢。

examples.en: Walk slowly with the hot drinks.
examples.tc: 拿着熱飲請走慢一點。

senses.glossEn: With attention so you avoid mistakes or harm.
senses.glossTc: 小心留意，以免出錯或受傷。

examples.en: Count the cash carefully.
examples.tc: 小心清點現金。

examples.en: Carry the glass jars carefully to the shelf.
examples.tc: 小心把玻璃瓶拿到貨架。

examples.en: Read the refund policy carefully before you promise.
examples.tc: 答應前請小心閱讀退款政策。

senses.glossEn: Most of the time; as a habit.
senses.glossTc: 大多數時候；作為習慣。

examples.en: We usually open at ten.
examples.tc: 我們通常十時開店。

examples.en: I usually take the MTR, not a taxi.
examples.tc: 我通常乘港鐵，不坐的士。

examples.en: The supplier usually confirms on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 供應商通常用 WhatsApp 確認。

senses.glossEn: Every time; without exception.
senses.glossTc: 每次都是；沒有例外。

examples.en: Always lock the till when you step away.
examples.tc: 離開收銀時一定要鎖好。

examples.en: I always tap Octopus at this gate.
examples.tc: 我在這個閘機總是拍八達通。

examples.en: She always checks WhatsApp before the meeting.
examples.tc: 她開會前總會看 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: Not at any time.
senses.glossTc: 在任何時間都不。

examples.en: Never leave the till drawer open.
examples.tc: 千萬不要讓收銀錢箱開着。

examples.en: I never take calls on the crowded MTR.
examples.tc: 我從不在擠迫的港鐵聽電話。

examples.en: We never refund without a receipt.
examples.tc: 沒有收據我們從不退款。

senses.glossEn: On some occasions, but not always.
senses.glossTc: 有些時候，但不是每次。

examples.en: Sometimes the MTR is faster than a taxi.
examples.tc: 有時港鐵比的士快。

examples.en: We sometimes open a second till before lunch.
examples.tc: 我們有時在午飯前開第二部收銀機。

examples.en: The supplier sometimes sends photos on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 供應商有時用 WhatsApp 傳相片。

senses.glossEn: On this day.
senses.glossTc: 在這一天。

examples.en: The shop closes earlier today.
examples.tc: 店舖今天提早關門。

examples.en: I have two meetings today.
examples.tc: 我今天有兩個會議。

examples.en: Today the till is taking FPS only.
examples.tc: 今天收銀處只收轉數快。

senses.glossEn: On the day after today.
senses.glossTc: 在今天之後的那一天。

examples.en: The delivery comes tomorrow morning.
examples.tc: 送貨明天早上到。

examples.en: Can we meet tomorrow after the MTR rush?
examples.tc: 我們可否明天在港鐵高峰後見面？

examples.en: I will send the WhatsApp tomorrow.
examples.tc: 我明天才發 WhatsApp。

senses.glossEn: On the day before today.
senses.glossTc: 在今天之前的那一天。

examples.en: Yesterday the queue reached the street.
examples.tc: 昨天排隊排到街上。

examples.en: I sent the invoice yesterday.
examples.tc: 我昨天已寄出發票。

examples.en: The till update failed yesterday, so we rolled back.
examples.tc: 昨天收銀更新失敗，所以我們還原了。

senses.glossEn: Not far from here.
senses.glossTc: 距離這裏不遠。

examples.en: There is a bank nearby.
examples.tc: 附近有銀行。

examples.en: I parked the trolley nearby while I opened the till.
examples.tc: 我開收銀機時把手推車停在附近。

examples.en: Eat nearby if the meeting overruns.
examples.tc: 若會議超時，就在附近吃。

senses.glossEn: On or to a lower floor.
senses.glossTc: 在較低的樓層，或往較低樓層。

examples.en: The stockroom is downstairs.
examples.tc: 貨倉在樓下。

examples.en: I will bring the spare till roll downstairs.
examples.tc: 我會把備用收銀紙拿到樓下。

examples.en: Meet the courier downstairs at the loading bay.
examples.tc: 在樓下卸貨區見速遞。

senses.glossEn: On or to a higher floor.
senses.glossTc: 在較高的樓層，或往較高樓層。

examples.en: Accounts sits upstairs.
examples.tc: 會計在樓上。

examples.en: Take the returns upstairs after closing.
examples.tc: 關門後把退貨拿到樓上。

examples.en: The meeting room upstairs is free at three.
examples.tc: 樓上會議室三時有空。

senses.glossEn: Not inside a building.
senses.glossTc: 不在建築物裏面。

examples.en: Please wait outside if the shop is full.
examples.tc: 若店內已滿，請在外面等候。

examples.en: The queue started outside before we opened.
examples.tc: 我們未開店，外面已開始排隊。

examples.en: I took the supplier call outside.
examples.tc: 我在外面接供應商電話。

senses.glossEn: In the inner part of a place.
senses.glossTc: 在地方的內部。

examples.en: Come inside; it is raining.
examples.tc: 進來吧，外面下雨。

examples.en: Keep the receipts inside the till drawer.
examples.tc: 把收據放在收銀錢箱裏面。

examples.en: The fitting rooms are inside on the left.
examples.tc: 試身室在裏面左邊。

senses.glossEn: It is possible; not certain.
senses.glossTc: 有可能；不確定。

examples.en: Maybe we should open a second till.
examples.tc: 也許我們應開第二部收銀機。

examples.en: I will maybe take a taxi if I miss this MTR.
examples.tc: 若趕不上這班港鐵，我或許坐的士。

examples.en: Maybe the supplier already sent WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 也許供應商已發了 WhatsApp。

synonyms.difference: Perhaps is a little more formal.

senses.glossEn: In fact; very.
senses.glossTc: 事實上；非常。

examples.en: The queue is really long today.
examples.tc: 今天排隊真的很長。

examples.en: I really need the till key before six.
examples.tc: 我真的要在六時前拿到收銀鎖匙。

examples.en: Was the WhatsApp really from the customer?
examples.tc: 那則 WhatsApp 真的是顧客發的嗎？

senses.glossEn: More than is wanted; also.
senses.glossTc: 超出想要的程度；也。

examples.en: This bag is too small.
examples.tc: 這個袋子太小。

examples.en: I am too tired to count the till twice.
examples.tc: 我太累，不想清點收銀兩次。

examples.en: The MTR was delayed, and the bus was late too.
examples.tc: 港鐵誤點，巴士也遲了。

senses.glossEn: To a high degree.
senses.glossTc: 程度很高。

examples.en: The customer was very patient in the queue.
examples.tc: 顧客在排隊時非常有耐心。

examples.en: This box is very heavy; use the trolley.
examples.tc: 這個箱子很重，請用手推車。

examples.en: I am very close to the MTR now.
examples.tc: 我現在離港鐵很近。

senses.glossEn: Fairly; more than a little.
senses.glossTc: 頗為；不只一點點。

examples.en: The shop is quite busy for a Monday.
examples.tc: 以星期一來說，店舖頗忙。

examples.en: I am quite sure the invoice is in the email.
examples.tc: 我頗肯定發票在電郵裏。

examples.en: The walk from the MTR is quite short.
examples.tc: 由港鐵步行頗短。

senses.glossEn: As much as is needed.
senses.glossTc: 達到所需的分量。

examples.en: Is there enough change in the till?
examples.tc: 收銀機零錢夠不夠？

examples.en: I did not leave home early enough.
examples.tc: 我出門不夠早。

examples.en: The bag is large enough for two boxes.
examples.tc: 這個袋子夠大，可放兩個盒子。

senses.glossEn: With each other, in one group.
senses.glossTc: 彼此一起，成為一組。

examples.en: Let's count the till together.
examples.tc: 我們一起清點收銀吧。

examples.en: We walked to the MTR together after closing.
examples.tc: 關門後我們一起行去港鐵。

examples.en: Put the receipts together in one envelope.
examples.tc: 把收據放在同一個信封。

senses.glossEn: Without other people.
senses.glossTc: 沒有其他人。

examples.en: Do not close the shop alone.
examples.tc: 不要獨自關門。

examples.en: I rode the MTR alone after the meeting.
examples.tc: 會議後我獨自乘港鐵。

examples.en: The junior staff should not handle refunds alone.
examples.tc: 初級同事不應獨自處理退款。

senses.glossEn: A very short time ago, or only.
senses.glossTc: 剛剛；僅僅。

examples.en: The supplier has just arrived.
examples.tc: 供應商剛剛到達。

examples.en: I just missed that MTR.
examples.tc: 我剛剛趕不上那班港鐵。

examples.en: We have just enough bags for the queue.
examples.tc: 袋子剛剛夠這條隊伍用。

senses.glossEn: No more than this; nothing else.
senses.glossTc: 只有這個；沒有其他。

examples.en: This till takes cards only.
examples.tc: 這個收銀處只收卡。

examples.en: I only need five minutes on WhatsApp.
examples.tc: 我只需五分鐘處理 WhatsApp。

examples.en: There is only one spare key.
examples.tc: 只有一把備用鎖匙。
